llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Kandinsky image and video API helper, but it should be reviewed because it sends bearer-token authenticated requests and user media to a default plain-HTTP IP address.

dimensions.detail: The capabilities match the stated purpose: text/image/video/avatar generation through Kandinsky API endpoints, including prompts, images, audio, polling, and saving generated results.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The trigger phrases are broad for general image-generation requests, and the skill does not require explicit confirmation before uploading photos or audio for i2i, i2v, super-resolution, or avatar flows.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains only markdown skill instructions and references; no executable install scripts, symlinks, or package-install behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires KANDINSKY_API_TOKEN and defaults KANDINSKY_API_BASE to http://87.242.117.37:5051, meaning bearer credentials, prompts, images, and audio may be sent to a remote service over plain HTTP unless the user overrides the base URL.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No background workers, persistence hooks, privilege escalation, local credential harvesting, broad file indexing, or destructive local actions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the Kandinsky API operator and the token scope. Prefer setting KANDINSKY_API_BASE to an HTTPS endpoint you control or trust, and avoid uploading sensitive face photos, private images, or voice recordings unless you are comfortable sending them to that service.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Broad generation-related triggers are coherent for an image/video generation skill, but they increase the chance of accidental activation of this specific external service.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending prompts, images, and audio is expected for the advertised API workflows, but the artifact lacks a clear privacy warning and confirmation guidance for sensitive media uploads.
